title: Prove it! Math Academy
text:
Prove it! Math Academy is a two-week summer program that serves as a bridge between programs/contests that emphasize computational abilities and those that expect students to be well-versed in proof writing. Held in scenic Fort Collins, CO at Colorado State University, the program leads participants through an exciting and challenging two-week course emphasizing mathematical rigor and proof-writing skills in a problem-solving context.

The 2020 Prove it! Math Academy will be held from June 22 to July 5, 2020.

To learn more or apply, see http://proveitmath.org.
